scope: Four-TU source-audit benchmark only; not a full board or Python comparison
limitations: Concurrent engineering host; no exclusive CPU reservation and filesystem/compiler caches may be warm.
Aggregate parent and recursive-child RSS sampled every 20 ms; not a hard peak guarantee or total-system memory including page cache.
Four observed child processes are two Clang drivers and two cc1 children, not four source-audit workers.
No detector, manifest coverage, registry, macro preprocessing or verdict was removed or cached.
Full-audit and full-board timings must be measured independently. Historical Python baseline remains exclusively 0e9bbc913bab77f9cd228940db2a332d25d6bfa1.
